messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Please use https://community.rstudio.com
parts:
Hi everyone -

We at RStudio have set up a new web site for discussions, at https://community.rstudio.com. The web site is running Discourse, which is an excellent community discussion platform. In the future, please use that web site, as we will be focusing our energy there, instead of on this Google Group.

- The Shiny Team at RStudio
